label: Illustrative multi-hub roles and continuity scenario; not a real staffing or business-continuity plan.

review_cadence.output: Prioritized work, named next owner, due date and escalations
Recurring exceptions, remediation actions and candidate product changes
CDE quality, service trends, control evidence, risks and decisions for the next period

roles.responsibilities: Prioritization, escalation, service scorecard and continuity coordination
Match review, survivorship exceptions, maker-checker coordination and data-owner follow-up
Rule monitoring, CDE lineage evidence, exception analysis and monthly scorecard preparation
Source-to-target mappings, feed exceptions, migration readiness and engineering backlog

continuity_scenarios.scenario: Primary hub unavailable for one business day
continuity_scenarios.trigger: Queue review confirms primary hub cannot perform scheduled work.
continuity_scenarios.fallback: Backup hub accepts priority cases from a shared queue; use the source map, current exception log and handover notes; defer non-critical change releases until the accountable reviewer is available.
continuity_scenarios.evidence: Handover checklist, accepted case ownership, open-risk list and next review time.
continuity_scenarios.validation: TABLETOP_REQUIRED; no exercise is claimed as completed.

continuity_scenarios.scenario: Source feed fails validation during a migration window
continuity_scenarios.trigger: Required-field or reconciliation threshold breached in a synthetic release check.
continuity_scenarios.fallback: Hold affected records, preserve source extracts and reconciliation output, notify source and technology owners, and resume only after a documented retest and approval.
continuity_scenarios.evidence: Run identifier, source-to-target mapping version, exception log, retest result and checker sign-off.
continuity_scenarios.validation: ILLUSTRATIVE_RUNBOOK; no production feed or migration is connected.
